title: The 2e−vs. 4e− pathways for ORR in rechargeable zinc–air batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1899-1915
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07166F, Perspective
Mingjie Wu, Xiaoya Zhan, Siyi Yang, Junjie Zheng, Xun Cui, Bao Yu Xia, Shuhui Sun, Yingkui Yang
The 2e− ORR pathway can reduce energy loss and improve charge–discharge rates in zinc–air batteries. Additionally, the generated H2O2 intermediate can be chemically or electrochemically utilized, enhancing overall battery capacity and efficiency.
